```{r config, include=FALSE}

# Input locations. Set these before knitting.
DATA_ROOT <- "" # project data directory (per-analysis subdirectories)
```

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
set.seed(0)

knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = file.path(DATA_ROOT, "Graph_descriptive_statistics/"))

library(ggplot2)
library(cowplot)
library(scales)
library("dplyr")
library(factoextra)
library(tidyr)
source(file.path(REPO_ROOT, "shared-R", "CS_Aesthetic.R"))
source(file.path(REPO_ROOT, "shared-R", "JFMV_2025_Aesthetic.R"))
library(ggrepel)
library(gridExtra)
library(reshape2)
library(ggbeeswarm)

library(ComplexUpset)
library(dplyr)
library(patchwork)
library(data.table)
```

```{r import_data}
# Import data
fread("tables/cov_hist.tsv")-> cov_hist
# remove all nodes with node of 0
cov_hist <- cov_hist[cov_hist$node != 0, ]
```

```{r plot_cov_hist bp, fig.width=4, fig.height=2}
ggplot(cov_hist, aes(x = count, y = bp/1e9)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill = "steelblue") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = pretty_breaks()) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = pretty_breaks()) +
  labs(x = "Number of paths", y = "Base pairs (Gb)") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 12))
```

```{r plot_cov_hist edge, fig.width=4, fig.height=2}
ggplot(cov_hist, aes(x = count, y = edge/1e6)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill = "steelblue") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = pretty_breaks()) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = pretty_breaks()) +
  labs(x = "Number of paths", y = "Number of edges\n(millions)") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 12))
```

```{r plot_cov_hist node, fig.width=4, fig.height=2}
ggplot(cov_hist, aes(x = count, y = node/1e6)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill = "steelblue") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = pretty_breaks()) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = pretty_breaks()) +
  labs(x = "Number of paths", y = "Number of nodes\n(millions)") +

```

```{r rm hist}
rm(cov_hist)
```

```{r import node_dist}
# Import data
fread("tables/node_dist.tsv")-> node_dist
```

```{r plot_node_dist_points, fig.width=4, fig.height=2}
library(data.table)
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)

nd <- copy(node_dist)

nd[, Coverage_r := round(Coverage, 6)]
nd[, Log_Length_r := round(`Log-Length`, 6)]

ggplot(nd, aes(x = Coverage_r, y = Log_Length_r, fill = `Log-Size` / 1e6)) +
  geom_point(shape = 23, size = 4, stroke = 0) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = pretty_breaks()) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = pretty_breaks()) +
  labs(
    x = "Coverage",
    y = "Log-Length",
    fill = "Nodes (millions)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 12))
```

```{r rm node_dist}
rm(node_dist)
```

```{r import growth}
# Import data
fread("tables/pan_growth.tsv")-> growth
```

```{r parse_growth}
growth_raw <- copy(growth)

metric_names <- names(growth_raw)
count_vals   <- as.numeric(growth_raw$count[4:nrow(growth_raw)])

growth_list <- vector("list", length(metric_names) - 1)

for (j in 2:length(metric_names)) {
  growth_list[[j - 1]] <- data.table(
    metric   = metric_names[j],
    coverage = as.numeric(growth_raw[[j]][1]),
    quorum   = as.numeric(growth_raw[[j]][2]),
    count    = count_vals,
    value    = as.numeric(growth_raw[[j]][4:nrow(growth_raw)])
  )
}

growth_long <- rbindlist(growth_list)

growth_long <- growth_long[
  !is.na(metric) &
  !is.na(coverage) &
  !is.na(quorum) &
  !is.na(count) &
  !is.na(value)
]
```


```{r plot_growth_node, fig.width=4, fig.height=2}
growth_node <- growth_long[metric == "node"]

ggplot(growth_node, aes(x = count, y = value / 1e6, color = factor(coverage))) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(1, 87)) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = pretty_breaks()) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = pretty_breaks()) +
  labs(
    x = "Number of assemblies",
    y = "Cumulative nodes\n(millions)",
    color = "Coverage"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 12)) +
  scale_color_viridis_d(begin = 0.2, end = 0.9)
```
